The seat still stands in data/reconstruction/1835_platted_seats.json and the refusal in data/reconstruction/1835_roof_keepers.json § refused, which names the household; this note deliberately does not, because naming it here is the claim the ruling forbids. WHETHER THAT IS A SHORTAGE, MEASURED: 0 unseated household(s) of this same clause and division carry a source for their name and are refused a roof by no ruling (1835_roof_keepers.json § households_left, re-derived from the deal's own owed rows on every commit). So the town really has run out of people this clause may seat here, and an empty cottage on this lot is the honest answer rather than a gap. The roof itself is unchanged: a conjectural count-unit of the 665-roof programme, adopted by nobody, its existence, position and footprint as invented as before.
